_comment: Monorepo whose components are reviewed as independent MRs. `scope` is the commit-message token used for fix commits: fix(<scope>): address QA round N.
_lenses_comment: Project conventions appended to a lens's generic contract. `focus` instead of `extra` would replace the shipped text. Keys are LENS NAMES, not lens_tags.

api-envelope.extra: Every response is {ok, error, data}; callers check ok before reading data. Timestamps are integer seconds since the epoch.
